_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-01 mergewatch.ai#626: the clean-verdict wording changed from "All clear! No issues found — this PR looks good to go" to "Looks good to me! I didn't find anything worth raising in this diff". The old text asserted ABSENCE the review never verified (nothing checks that silence was right) and appended a merge recommendation covering tests and CI that MergeWatch never reads. The new phrasing is a first-person judgement, which is what the product is actually entitled to say — it already submits a formal APPROVE at 4-5. mergewatch.ai#706: approving is opt-in (`approve: true` on the default branch), so with defaults a 4-5 score submits a COMMENT review, not APPROVE. mergewatch.ai#710: the safety score is off by default, so a default-config review must carry no `<!-- mw-safety:` line; this fails the gate if it ever turns on by default.
_variance: Whether a clean diff draws zero warnings, a 5/5 and a COMMENT review is the model's judgement; one spurious warning flips score, check and review state.
